$comment: Template project memory for oh-my-cursor. Copy to ./project-memory.json in your workspace and edit. scripts/validate-project-memory.py validates the schema. The MARKER fields named *_marker are not data; they document which keys are user-owned and must not be overwritten by automated rescans.

userOwned.$comment: Keys under userOwned are protected from automated rescans. customNotes and directives are append-only from the agent's perspective. Removal requires an explicit human edit.
